Rishi / Ben — internal notes only (do not forward verbatim to customer). I reviewed the complaint and the current order-form language. My recommended approach is to accept indemnity responsibility for covered third-party claims but to condition defense control acceptance on three operational safeguards. Below are the suggested guardrails and a short redline snippet you can offer BrightLabs as a compromise.

Key guardrails (recommended):
- Defense control is accepted by Redwood provided BrightLabs: (a) delivers a written claim notice with reasonable detail; (b) preserves and transfers relevant evidence within 10 business days; (c) does not settle a claim without Redwood's prior written consent.
- Insurance offset: allow Redwood to reduce indemnity payments by the amount actually recovered under BrightLabs’ commercial general liability or product liability insurance that applies to the single claim. This avoids double recovery and is standard.
- Cap / cost allocation: propose a per-claim cap tied to the order form's committed spend tier (e.g., lesser of $2M or 12 months of order-form fees) — only if procurement pushes hard; otherwise aim for uncapped defense with reimbursement carveouts.

Suggested redline (language snippet to propose to BrightLabs):
"Redwood will defend and indemnify Customer from third-party claims arising directly from Redwood's infringement of a third party's intellectual property to the extent set forth in the MSA. Redwood shall provide prompt written notice of any claim and shall assume defense of the claim with counsel of its choosing, subject to Customer's right to participate at Customer's expense. Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation and shall deliver all non-privileged evidence in its possession within ten (10) business days of notice. Any recovery or payment by Customer's insurer that directly relates to the claim will reduce Redwood's indemnity obligation dollar-for-dollar."

Operational asks:
- Ben: please compile a minimal evidence checklist (logs, model hash, prompt snapshot, dataset IDs) we can share on the call.
- Rishi: on the call, lead with the proposed redline above and emphasize our willingness to accept defense control with the listed guardrails.

I will draft a one-page legal summary and a tracked-redline order form we can send to Marta. Target: shared redline within 48 hours per your timeline.
